subject: Segfault: Shiny 0.8.0, R version 3.0.1, running on ubuntu

messages.author: 864794da3a3323c3
messages.subject: Segfault: Shiny 0.8.0, R version 3.0.1, running on ubuntu
parts:
Dear all,
I need help again.

My Shiny dash crashes, and I can't quite understand why --
it loads the following packages on the start:

require(shiny)
require(googleVis)
library(RPostgreSQL)

Then it segfaults (it used to run just fine, it segfaulted with this error before, but updating the httpuv package to 1.2.2 helped somehow, but that's the latest version, no more possibility of upgrades!).

Parts of the trace are below:

42: doTryCatch(return(expr), name, parentenv, handler)
43: tryCatchOne(expr, names, parentenv, handlers[[1L]])
44: tryCatchList(expr, classes, parentenv, handlers)
45: tryCatch(expr, error = function(e) {    call <- conditionCall(e)    if (!is.null(call)) {        if (identical(call[[1L]], quote(doTryCatch)))             call <- sys.call(-4L)        dcall <- deparse(call)[1L]        prefix <- paste("Error in", dcall, ": ")        LONG <- 75L        msg <- conditionMessage(e)        sm <- strsplit(msg, " ")[[1L]]        w <- 14L + nchar(dcall, type = "w") + nchar(sm[1L], type = "w")        if (is.na(w))             w <- 14L + nchar(dcall, type = "b") + nchar(sm[1L],                 type = "b")        if (w > LONG)             prefix <- paste0(prefix, "   ")    }    else prefix <- "Error : "    msg <- paste0(prefix, conditionMessage(e), " ")    .Internal(seterrmessage(msg[1L]))    if (!silent && identical(getOption("show.error.messages"),         TRUE)) {        cat(msg, file = stderr())        .Internal(printDeferredWarnings())    }    invisible(structure(msg, class = "try-error", condition = e))})
46: try(shinyCallingHandlers(func()), silent = FALSE)
47: func()
48: withCallingHandlers(expr, error = function(e) {    handle <- getOption("shiny.error")    if (is.function(handle))         handle()})
49: shinyCallingHandlers(func())
50: env$runWith(.self, func)
51: ctx$run(.func)
52: run()
53: func()
54: withCallingHandlers({    func()}, warning = function(e) {}, error = function(e) {})
55: FUN(X[[1L]], ...)
56: lapply(.flushCallbacks, function(func) {    withCallingHandlers({        func()    }, warning = function(e) {    }, error = function(e) {    })})
57: ctx$executeFlushCallbacks()
58: .getReactiveEnvironment()$flush()
59: flushReact()
60: handler(binary, message)
61: doTryCatch(return(expr), name, parentenv, handler)
62: tryCatchOne(expr, names, parentenv, handlers[[1L]])
63: tryCatchList(expr, classes, parentenv, handlers)
64: tryCatch(expr, error = function(e) {    call <- conditionCall(e)    if (!is.null(call)) {        if (identical(call[[1L]], quote(doTryCatch)))             call <- sys.call(-4L)        dcall <- deparse(call)[1L]        prefix <- paste("Error in", dcall, ": ")        LONG <- 75L        msg <- conditionMessage(e)        sm <- strsplit(msg, " ")[[1L]]        w <- 14L + nchar(dcall, type = "w") + nchar(sm[1L], type = "w")        if (is.na(w))             w <- 14L + nchar(dcall, type = "b") + nchar(sm[1L],                 type = "b")        if (w > LONG)             prefix <- paste0(prefix, "   ")    }    else prefix <- "Error : "    msg <- paste0(prefix, conditionMessage(e), " ")    .Internal(seterrmessage(msg[1L]))    if (!silent && identical(getOption("show.error.messages"),         TRUE)) {        cat(msg, file = stderr())        .Internal(printDeferredWarnings())    }    invisible(structure(msg, class = "try-error", condition = e))})
65: try(handler(binary, message))  
66: 66: (function (handle, binary, message) {    for (handler in .wsconns[[as.character(handle)]]$.messageCallbacks) {        result <- try(handler(binary, message))        if (inherits(result, "try-error")) {            .wsconns[[as.character(handle)]]$close()            return()        }    }})(  + bits from the data I am parsing

..
69: doTryCatch(return(expr), name, parentenv, handler)
70: tryCatchOne(expr, names, parentenv, handlers[[1L]])
71: tryCatchList(expr, classes, parentenv, handlers)
72: tryCatch(evalq((function (handle, binary, message) {    for (handler in .wsconns[[as.character(handle)]]$.messageCallbacks) {        result <- try(handler(binary, message))        if (inherits(result, "try-error")) {            .wsconns[[as.character(handle)]]$close()   

....

73: .Call("httpuv_run", PACKAGE = "httpuv", timeoutMillis)
74: run(timeoutMs)
75: service(timeout)
76: serviceApp()
77: withCallingHandlers(expr, error = function(e) {    handle <- getOption("shiny.error")    if (is.function(handle))         handle()})
78: shinyCallingHandlers(while (!.globals$stopped) {    serviceApp()    Sys.sleep(0.001)})
79: runApp(Sys.getenv("SHINY_APP"), port = as.integer(Sys.getenv("SHINY_PORT")),     launch.browser = FALSE)
aborting ...
Segmentation fault (core dumped)


Any suggestions on what to try?
Thanks!
-Betty

messages.subject: Re: Segfault: Shiny 0.8.0, R version 3.0.1, running on ubuntu
parts:
Hm, that sounds strange. Here are a few things to try:

* Try reinstalling the following packages: install.packages(c("Rcpp", "httpuv", "shiny"))
* Upgrade to R 3.0.2
* Delete your existing package library and re-install all packages.

-Winston
